work.title: Work
work.intro: I've contributed to projects spanning software engineering, AI solutions, mentoring and team leadership. This is an overview of my professional journey.

highlights: Building estacionar.me, a parking reservation platform for Argentina: drivers discover and book parking spots, operators manage their garages.
Owning the full product: an Expo (React Native) driver app, a Next.js operator dashboard and a Hono + tRPC API.
PostgreSQL with PostGIS and Drizzle ORM, deployed to AWS (Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront) with SST.
Building ActioTicket, a SaaS platform modernizing public transport ticketing in Spain, serving operators like Navarra and Sabadell.
Designed a multi-brand theme architecture with Next.js, TypeScript and Material UI, with custom styling per operator.
Implemented the end-to-end origin–destination ticket purchase flow — routes, dates, fares and checkout — for the Navarra operator.
Refactored key components with the Composite pattern, improving reuse across brands, and kept unit test coverage above 80% with Vitest and React Testing Library.

crombieAiLead.role: AI Lead Engineer · Center of Excellence
highlights: Technical lead of a new team designing AI-driven solutions: intelligent agents with custom tools and controlled workflows.
Translated solution designs into requirements for team task division.
Vercel AI SDK, AWS Bedrock, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Langchain.
Puma e-commerce across the U.S., Canada, UK, Japan and India with Next.js (SSR + CSR) and Sanity as headless CMS.
Improved LCP from 4.5s to 3.8s by tracing duplicate server requests with Google Cloud Trace, and cut bundle size by 20% with dynamic imports.
Implemented technical SEO (rendering strategy, dynamic metadata, structured data, sitemaps) and GA4 e-commerce tracking.
Built and maintained a shared Storybook component library across markets; unit and E2E testing with React Testing Library and Cypress.
Taught JavaScript, TypeScript and React in the second edition of Escuelita Crombie, the company's internal dev school.
Led a team of 4 building Crombie's website with Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS and TypeScript.
Configured Bitbucket pipelines for automated AWS deployments, managing infrastructure with SST.
Ran code reviews and mentored new developers.
MVP for equipment management and preventive maintenance: REST API with Python and Django REST Framework.
Interactive UIs (forms, tables, dashboards, charts) with React, Vite, React Query and Material UI. Over 80% unit test coverage.
Inventory management and an Excel-based cost and pricing system for GAUSS retail products.
Redesigned the plant floor layout to implement Just-In-Time with KANBAN cards.

unl.note: Systems thinking, process optimization and project management applied to software.

henry.note: Intensive full-time program: JavaScript, React, Node.js, SQL.

cv.profileSummary: I turn complex problems into simple, scalable software. Industrial engineering left me with a method: break it down, understand the constraints, and solve with the minimum necessary. Working across different products and domains taught me that the best tool is usually the one the context calls for, not the one I already know.

bullets: Building ActioTicket, the SaaS platform modernizing public transport ticketing in Spain, now with 10,000+ registered users in production.
Designed the multi-brand theming architecture that lets new operators launch under their own branding without duplicating code, built with Next.js, TypeScript and Material UI.
Implemented the origin–destination purchase flow end to end — routes, dates, fares and checkout.
Refactored key components around the Composite pattern so brands reuse the same base, keeping test coverage above 80% with Vitest and React Testing Library.
Apply Spec-Driven Development (OpenSpec): every change is specced before implementation, reducing ambiguity and rework.
First technical lead of the AI Center of Excellence: designed agents with custom tools and controlled workflows on Vercel AI SDK, AWS Bedrock and Langchain.
Built an internal agent that resolves the CX team's repetitive queries, cutting their operational load by around 20%.

As Sr. FullStack Engineer on Puma's global e-commerce (US, Canada, UK, Japan and India), improved LCP from 4.5s to 3.8s by eliminating duplicate server requests and cut the bundle by 20% with dynamic imports.
Implemented Puma's technical SEO strategy and GA4 e-commerce tracking, and contributed components to the cross-market design system, documented in Storybook.
Led a 4-person team building Crombie's own site with Next.js App Router, set up AWS deploy pipelines with SST, and mentored new developers.
